public_statement.summary: An actor attempted to exploit a VM-level atomicity issue, causing invalid state changes. Network progression is paused to prevent further impact. A fix is prepared and is being validated on a shadow fork; deployment will be coordinated with validators, exchanges and infrastructure partners. A targeted recovery that preserves finalized history and legitimate user state while addressing only incident-related invalid changes is being evaluated. Attacker accounts identified and frozen in coordination with exchanges. Users asked not to transact or use deposits/withdrawals.
